description: Check whether a cron expression is valid. Returns valid true with the expanded values of every field (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, and seconds for 6-field expressions), or valid false with an error code, the field at fault and a message. Detects schedules that can never run (e.g. February 30). Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/validate.

expression.description: Cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5", "*/15 * * * *", "0 30 8 * * *" (6 fields = leading seconds) or "@daily".

name: validate_cron
title: Validate a cron expression
